name: awesome-claude-code
description: Production-tested Claude Code skills, commands, agents and hooks.

plugins.name: prevent-main-commit
plugins.description: Blocks Claude Code from committing directly to main or master.

plugins.name: pre-commit-quality-gate
plugins.description: Runs lint and typecheck on staged files and blocks Claude's git commit if they fail.

plugins.name: post-edit-lint
plugins.description: Lints each file right after Claude edits it and feeds errors back to Claude.

plugins.name: pr-walkthrough
plugins.description: Generates a pedagogical HTML walkthrough of a PR or feature branch.

plugins.name: visual-explainer
plugins.description: Generates self-contained HTML diagrams, tables and visual explanations (by nicobailon).

plugins.name: icon-generation
plugins.description: Generates app icons and favicons from HTML/CSS via headless Chrome.

plugins.name: useeffect-review
plugins.description: Reviews React code for unnecessary or incorrect useEffect usage.

plugins.name: playwright-e2e
plugins.description: Guides Playwright end-to-end tests toward semantic locators and auto-retrying assertions.

plugins.name: readme-writer
plugins.description: Writes READMEs that explain architecture and design decisions rather than restating types.

plugins.name: claude-cli-backend
plugins.description: Reference for using claude -p as a programmatic LLM backend from Python.

plugins.name: autoresearch
plugins.description: Runs automated experiment loops: Optuna parameter sweeps or LLM-proposed changes.

plugins.name: calibration-eval
plugins.description: Generates HTML pages for collecting human ground-truth judgments.

plugins.name: knowledge-probe
plugins.description: Maps what a user knows about a topic, then writes a personalized explainer.

plugins.name: catchup
plugins.description: Reads all changed files on the current branch to restore context after /clear.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Groups the session's changes into logical commits with clear messages.

plugins.name: review-branch
plugins.description: Self-reviews the current branch before a PR (superseded by built-in /code-review).

plugins.name: review-feedback
plugins.description: Evaluates PR review comments for validity before fixing them.

plugins.name: rebase-stack
plugins.description: Rebases a stack of dependent PRs onto a target branch.

plugins.name: verify-docs
plugins.description: Detects drift between documentation and code.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Researches a codebase question with parallel subagents and writes a research document. Pairs with the codebase-locator and codebase-analyzer plugins.

plugins.name: codebase-analyzer
plugins.description: Read-only subagent that explains how code works, with file:line references.

plugins.name: codebase-locator
plugins.description: Subagent that finds where code lives (superseded by the built-in Explore agent).

plugins.name: code-reviewer
plugins.description: Subagent for structured code review with severity tiers.
